title: More Verbs That Work Like Gustar
goal: Say what bothers, worries or delights you with verbs like gustar and que + subjunctive.

sections.title: Unit 6: Emotional Reactions & Affective Stance
body: At B2 you do more than state facts: you say how things affect you. This unit is about reacting to what other people do, to news and to social problems, and about the subjunctive that follows.

You will practise verbs that work like gustar, verbs such as sentir, lamentar and temer, exclamations, and el hecho de que. The unit ends with a short text about the Uruguayan writer Eduardo Galeano and his book Las venas abiertas de América Latina.

items: I can say what bothers, worries or delights me with me molesta que, me preocupa que and me encanta que.
I can keep the verb singular when the que clause is the subject.
I can use the new words for worries and annoyances.
